item.title: ‘Salmon Party Perjury’ Lee Hwa-young Sentenced to 4 Months in Prison, People Power Party Says “Lee Jae-myung and the Ruling Party’s National Deception” (‘연어 술파티 위증’ 이화영 징역 4개월에, 국힘 “李·여당의 대국민 사기극")
item.description:
‘Salmon Party Perjury’ Lee Hwa-young Sentenced to 4 Months in Prison, People Power Party Says “Lee Jae-myung and the Ruling Party’s National Deception” (‘연어 술파티 위증’ 이화영 징역 4개월에, 국힘 “李·여당의 대국민 사기극")

On the 20th, the People Power Party (PPP) stated regarding Lee Hwa-young, former vice governor of Gyeonggi Province for peace affairs, who was indicted on charges including perjury after raising the ‘salmon drinking party’ allegation and received a first-instance sentence of four months in prison, that “the framing of ‘fabricated investigation’ by President Lee Jae-myung and the ruling party is a national deception.” <<> Senior spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said in a commentary that day, “The truth behind the ‘salmon drinking party at the prosecution office’ allegation, which deceived the public and mocked the judiciary, has finally been revealed,” adding, “It has become clear that the ‘fabricated investigation’ framing by the ruling party and President Lee Jae-myung, which has shaken South Korea for the past two years and three months, demonized the prosecution, and undermined the foundations of democracy, was ultimately a deception against the nation.” <<> Senior spokesperson Park continued, “Until now, the former vice governor’s lies were the Democratic Party’s key script to portray the entire Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance case as a ‘fabricated investigation by the prosecution,’” and “The Democratic Party treated these false claims like a sacred cow, abused hearings and parliamentary investigations in the National Assembly, and rampaged by threatening to impeach prosecutors who conducted legitimate investigations. They even pushed for a ‘special counsel for withdrawal of indictment’ to erase President Lee’s judicial risks.” <<> He then said, “Attempts to shake the nation’s criminal justice system to ease one’s own judicial burden, target the prosecution and courts as political attacks, and undermine the rule of law itself cannot be justified.” <<> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also posted on Facebook that day, “Those who staged a shamanistic show of false accusations must be held accountable,” and “There was a cowardly parliamentary investigation that never even called me as a witness, and even a push for a special counsel to withdraw the indictment, but none of it could cover up the simple truth that the money Ssangbangwool gave to North Korea was ‘payment for Lee Jae-myung’s visit to the North.’” <<> He added, “If one insists on using power to eliminate one’s own trial, the only outcome for an enemy of democracy is impeachment and catastrophe,” and “Those who collaborate on that path will also ultimately be held responsible.” <<> Earlier that day, at a sentencing hearing for the former vice governor under a citizen participation trial presided over by Criminal Division 11 of the Suwon District Court (Presiding Judge Song Byeong-hoon), the court sentenced him to four months in prison for violating the Act on Testimony and Appraisal before the National Assembly (perjury). The court deemed that the former vice governor’s testimony about the existence of a salmon drinking party to manipulate statements was false. (국민의힘은 20일 ‘연어 술 파티 의혹’을 제기해 위증 등 혐의로 기소된 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사가 1심에서 징역 4개월을 선고받은 것을 두고 “이재명 대통령과 여당의 ‘조작 수사’ 프레임은 대국민 사기극”이라고 했다.)

item.title: 'Impeachment of Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek' National Assembly Petition Reaches 100% in Three Days (‘안규백 국방장관 탄핵’ 국회 국민 청원 사흘만에 100%달성)
item.description:
'Impeachment of Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek' National Assembly Petition Reaches 100% in Three Days (‘안규백 국방장관 탄핵’ 국회 국민 청원 사흘만에 100%달성)

The National Assembly petition for the 'Impeachment of Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek' surpassed 50,000 signatures on the 20th, achieving the required number. The petition calling for the suspension of the Korea Military Academy (KMA) merger and relocation to a provincial area also exceeded 36,000 signatures, expected to soon reach the required threshold. This reflects public backlash against the current government's defense policies, including the dissolution of the Defense Security Command and the integration of the three military academies, through National Assembly petitions. <<> According to the National Assembly e-petition, the 'Petition for the Impeachment of Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek,' posted on the 18th, recorded 50,902 signatures as of 10 a.m. on the 20th, just three days after its disclosure. If more than 50,000 people participate, the relevant standing committee of the National Assembly is required to review the petition. <<> The petitioner stated, "The Minister of National Defense is the highest authority constitutionally responsible for national security and territorial defense," adding, "Measures such as the dissolution of the Security Command, dispersal of its core functions, and the lack of accountability in the death of a reserve soldier have heightened public concern over national security and troop safety. Accordingly, we petition the National Assembly to thoroughly investigate the propriety of the Minister's performance and seek his impeachment." They further argued, "If the investigation confirms violations of the Constitution or laws as stipulated in Article 65 of the Constitution, the National Assembly should consider all legal measures, including impeachment proceedings." <<> Minister Ahn announced on the 10th a plan to dissolve the Defense Security Command (DSC) and transfer its core functions to the Defense Counterintelligence Headquarters, Defense Security Support Group, and Defense Ministry Investigation Headquarters, among others. This dissolves the command dedicated to counterintelligence and security, originally established as the Army Security Command in 1977, after 49 years. The military aims to complete the reorganization by the end of next month. Regarding the death of a 20-year-old reserve soldier in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd, "Thoroughly and swiftly investigate the truth and transparently disclose the facts to the public." The petitioner is interpreted as questioning Minister Ahn's actions in this context. <<> The petition titled 'Petition Calling for the Suspension of the Korea Military Academy Merger and Relocation to a Provincial Area,' disclosed on the 16th, had 36,378 signatures as of 10 a.m. on the 20th. Signatures can be collected until the 16th of next month, making achievement highly likely. The petitioner argued, "Discussions on merging and relocating the KMA, which could significantly impact national security and the overall military education system, are being pursued without sufficient public consensus or expert review," and "An unverified, hasty reorganization risks causing chaos in the officer training system and weakening national security capabilities." <<> The Ministry of National Defense is reportedly accelerating efforts to integrate the three military academies. Minister Ahn recently visited all three academies consecutively to gather input: the KMA on the 27th of last month, the Naval Academy on the 10th, and the Air Force Academy on the 15th. Lawmaker Lee Gae-ho of the Democratic Party (representing Damyang, Hampyeong, Yeonggwang, and Jangseong in South Jeolla Province) formally proposed to Minister Ahn on the 18th to relocate the KMA to Jangseong County, South Jeolla Province. Initially, the Ministry planned to release the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses' integration plan for the military academies, but has not yet done so, instead speeding up the integration process. This is reportedly in response to the involvement of several high-ranking KMA graduates in the planning and participation of the December 3 emergency martial law incident. (‘안규백 국방장관 탄핵’ 국회 국민 청원이 20일 5만명을 넘기며 필요 인원을 달성했다. 육군사관학교 통폐합 및 지방 이전 추진 중단 청원도 3만6000여 명을 넘겨 곧 필요 인원을 달성할 것으로 전망된다. 국군방첩사령부 해체, 3군 사관학교 통합 등 현 정부 국방 정책에 대해 국회 국민 청원을 통한 반발이 나타나는 모양새다.)

item.title: After Yoo Si-min Leaves the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation... Cho Kuk Donates 1 Million Won (유시민 떠난 노무현재단에... 조국, 100만원 후원했다)
item.description:
After Yoo Si-min Leaves the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation... Cho Kuk Donates 1 Million Won (유시민 떠난 노무현재단에... 조국, 100만원 후원했다)

Former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Cho Kuk, announced on the 20th that he donated 1 million won to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation. (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표는 노무현재단에 100만원을 후원했다고 20일 밝혔다.)

On that day, Cho posted on Facebook, "I made a one-time donation to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation," and verified the donation of 1 million won. He explained the foundation's history, saying, "The Roh Moo-hyun Foundation was established after figures from the participatory government, including Moon Jae-in, Han Myeong-sook, and Yoo Si-min, announced plans for its founding at President Roh's 49th-day funeral ceremony in 2009." He added, "The first chairman was Han Myeong-sook, followed by Moon Jae-in, Lee Byung-wan, Lee Hae-chan, Yoo Si-min, Chung Sye-kyun, and Cha Sung-soo, who served as chairmen in turn." (조 전 대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “노무현재단에 일시후원을 했다”며 100만원 후원 내역을 인증했다. 그는 “노무현재단은 2009년 노 대통령 49재 안장식에서 문재인·한명숙·유시민 등 참여정부 인사들이 설립계획을 발표한 후 설립되었습니다”며 “초대 이사장에 한명숙, 이후 문재인, 이병완, 이해찬, 유시민, 정세균, 차성수 등이 차례로 이사장을 맡았습니다”고 재단의 역사를 설명했다.)

This donation by former leader Cho came after writer Yoo Si-min stepped down from his position as managing director of the foundation on the 15th and left the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation. When Kwak Sang-eon, a Democratic Party lawmaker and son-in-law of former President Roh, said, "I'm not sure who the foundation is actually promoting," Yoo responded by saying, "For now, I will leave the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation and live apart," and added, "Please take good care of the foundation until we meet again," before departing. (이번 조 전 대표의 후원은 유시민 작가가 지난 15일 재단 상임이사 자리를 내려놓고 노무현재단을 떠난 상황에서 이뤄졌다. 노 전 대통령 사위인 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원이 ‘재단이 실질적으로 누구를 홍보하는지 모르겠다’고 하자 유 작가는 “저는 당분간 노무현재단을 떠나서 살려고 한다”며 “다시 만나는 날까지 재단을 잘 지켜달라”며 재단을 떠났다.)

In political circles, there is speculation that Cho Kuk's donation to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation is an expression of support for Yoo Si-min, who had helped him during elections. During the June 3 by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul constituency, Yoo had shown support for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party over the Democratic Party, saying, "I think electing Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party would be somewhat better than Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party." However, Cho finished third in the by-election, behind People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong and Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, losing the race. The day after the election, on the 4th, Cho stated, "I take responsibility for the election results and will resign as party leader." (정치권에서는 조 전 대표의 노무현재단 후원은 선거에서 자신을 도왔던 유 작가에 대한 지지 성격이 있다는 말이 나온다. 유 작가는 6·3 국회의원 경기 평택을 재선거 당시 “민주당 김용남보다는 조국혁신당 조국 후보 당선이 좀 낫지 않을까 싶다”고 하는 등 민주당이 아닌 조국혁신당을 지지하는 행보를 보였다. 하지만 조 전 대표는 재선거에서 국민의힘 유의동 후보와 민주당 김용남 후보에 이어 3위를 기록하며 낙선했다. 조 전 대표는 선거 다음날인 지난 4일 “선거 결과에 책임을 지고 당대표직에서 물러나겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon "Goal to Rejoin the People Power Party... Jang Dong-hyuk Has Lost Legitimacy to Lead the Conservatives" (한동훈 “국힘 복당 목표…장동혁 보수 이끌 정통성 상실”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon "Goal to Rejoin the People Power Party... Jang Dong-hyuk Has Lost Legitimacy to Lead the Conservatives" (한동훈 “국힘 복당 목표…장동혁 보수 이끌 정통성 상실” )

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon revealed his intention to rejoin the People Power Party (PPP) in an interview with Japan's Yomiuri Shimbun. Regarding the first year of the Lee Jae-myung government, he assessed that "the institutions and systems that have sustained South Korea are collapsing for the private interests of those in power." <<> In the interview published by Japan's Yomiuri Shimbun on this day, when asked whether he aimed to rejoin the party or rally a new conservative force, Han stated, "I aim to rejoin the People Power Party," adding, "but there is no need to rush." Han said, "My goal is for the conservative camp to become the majority party in the 2028 general election, and to reclaim power in the 2030 presidential election." Regarding the possibility of cooperation with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok, he said, "Rather than discussing specific individuals, I want to work with anyone who shares the goal of conservative reconstruction." On being elected as an independent in Busan's Buk-gu district, he commented, "I believe the voters expressed their will by entrusting me with the mandate to rebuild conservatism, restore balance in South Korea, and check the Democratic Party's excesses." <<> In response to the observation that rejoining the party would be difficult under the leadership of PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, Han said, "There are almost no party leaders who do not resign after a crushing defeat in nationwide local elections. Currently, he is only formally holding the party leadership, having already lost political authority and the legitimacy to lead the conservative camp." On whether he will run in the next presidential election, Han replied, "It depends on whether the people need me at that time." <<> When asked to evaluate the first year of the Lee Jae-myung government, Han said, "The biggest problem is that the institutions and systems supporting South Korea are collapsing for the private interests of President Lee and other power holders. Behind this, the conservative camp also bears responsibility for failing to provide adequate checks." Regarding the abolition of the prosecution service, he stated, "If it weren't for President Lee's own legal risks, such institutional reforms would not have occurred. Breaking down long-standing systems to suit the circumstances of those in power is dangerous." He further said that if he succeeds in achieving a change of government, he would "normalize" the prosecution. <<> Regarding the current government's push for an early recovery of wartime operational control (OPCON), Han stated, "If a transfer occurs, there are concerns it could impact the functioning of the South Korea-U.S. alliance. The framework of wartime OPCON has been the foundation that has enabled the operation of the alliance. Pushing for it based on ideology or to cater to a support base is problematic." (무소속 한동훈 의원이 일본 요미우리신문과의 인터뷰에서 국민의힘 복당 의사를 밝혔다. 이재명 정부 1년에 대해서는 “한국을 지탱해 온 제도와 시스템이 권력자들의 사적 이익을 위해 무너지고 있다”고 평가했다.)

item.title: Yoon Kun-young: “Noh Tae-ak Received First Report of Ballot Shortage 40 Minutes Before Polls Closed” (윤건영 “노태악, 투표 종료 40분 전에 ‘용지 부족’ 첫 보고 받아”)
item.description:
Yoon Kun-young: “Noh Tae-ak Received First Report of Ballot Shortage 40 Minutes Before Polls Closed” (윤건영 “노태악, 투표 종료 40분 전에 ‘용지 부족’ 첫 보고 받아”)

Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairperson Noh Tae-ak reportedly received the first report about a ballot shortage just 40 minutes before polls closed on the day of the June 3 local elections. (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 6·3 지방선거 당일, 투표 종료 40분 전에 첫 용지 부족 관련 보고를 받은 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to data submitted by the NEC to the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Kun-young on the 20th, former Chairperson Noh received a verbal report from an NEC spokesperson around 5:20 PM on the 3rd. It appears he first became aware of the ballot shortage only about 40 minutes before the regular voting ended. The former Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hun, who served as the practical head, and Deputy Secretary-General Kang Dong-wan also received their first verbal reports around the same time from the NEC’s public relations officer and a public relations assistant, respectively. (20일 윤건영 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위에서 제출받은 자료에 따르면 노 전 위원장은 지난 3일 오후 5시 20분쯤 중앙선관위 대변인의 구두 보고를 받았다. 본투표가 끝나기 약 40분 전에야 투표 용지 부족 상황을 처음으로 인지한 것으로 보인다. 실무 총책임자인 허철훈 전 사무총장과 강동완 사무차장 역시 비슷한 시각, 각각 중앙선관위 공보과장과 공보과 사무관으로부터 구두로 첫 보고를 받은 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, the NEC stated that it first recognized the ballot shortage at 5:08 PM on the day of the regular voting. However, according to the content submitted by the NEC to Yoon’s office, the NEC’s election situation room received a complaint call about a ballot shortage at the Garak 2-dong 3rd polling station around 4:25 PM. (앞서 중앙선관위는 본투표 당일 오후 5시 8분 용지 부족 사태를 최초로 인지했다고 밝혔다. 하지만 중앙선관위가 윤건영 의원실에 제출한 내용을 보면, 중앙선관위 선거상황실은 오후 4시 25분쯤 가락2동제3투표소 투표용지 부족 관련 항의 전화를 받았던 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Kim Dong-yeon, Ahead of Retirement, Visits Former President Moon Jae-in to Express Gratitude for Support (퇴임 앞둔 김동연, 文 예방해 “버팀목 되어줘 감사”)
item.description:
Kim Dong-yeon, Ahead of Retirement, Visits Former President Moon Jae-in to Express Gratitude for Support (퇴임 앞둔 김동연, 文 예방해 “버팀목 되어줘 감사”)

Kim Dong-yeon, the Gyeonggi Province Governor who will retire on the 30th, visited former President Moon Jae-in to convey his appreciation. (오는 30일 퇴임하는 김동연 경기도지사가 문재인 전 대통령을 예방하고 감사의 뜻을 표시했다.)

On the 20th, Governor Kim stated on his social media, "I visited former President Moon Jae-in a couple of days ago to say my farewell before retirement," adding, "I am grateful to the former president and his wife for warmly welcoming me. I also appreciate the dinner where we could share deep and enjoyable conversations." (김 지사는 20일 자신의 소셜미디어를 통해 “그제 문재인 전 대통령을 퇴임 인사차 찾았다”며 “반갑게 맞아준 대통령님 내외분에게 감사하다. 속깊은 이야기 재밌게 나눌 수 있었던 저녁 자리도 감사하다”고 했다.)

Governor Kim said, "The past four years leading Gyeonggi Province’s administration were a time of striving to realize the values of balanced development and inclusion in the daily lives of Gyeonggi residents, while pursuing people-centered governance," and expressed, "I felt and learned a great deal by directly putting the values of the Democratic Party and the governing philosophy of President Moon Jae-in into practice on the ground. I sincerely thank the president, who has always been a steadfast pillar of support for me." He added, "My duties as governor are now coming to an end, but I will continue to seek roles where I can contribute and carry forward those precious values." (김 지사는 “경기도정을 맡았던 지난 4년은 사람 중심 도정을 펴면서 균형발전과 포용의 가치를 경기도 삶의 현장에서 구현하기 위해 애쓴 시간이었다”며 “민주당의 가치와 문재인 대통령의 국정철학을 현장에서 직접 실천하며 많이 느끼고 많이 배웠다. 늘 든든한 버팀목이 되어주신 대통령에게 진심으로 감사드린다”고 말했다. 이어 “이제 도지사로서의 소임은 마무리하지만, 앞으로도 제가 할 수 있는 역할을 찾으며 그 귀한 가치를 이어가겠다”고 했다.)

Governor Kim, who has served as Gyeonggi Province Governor since 2022, lost to lawmaker Choo Mi-ae in the Democratic Party’s primary for the Gyeonggi Governor election last April. He returned to the governor’s post on the 20th of the same month and is now nearing the end of his term. (2022년부터 경기도지사를 맡아왔던 김 지사는 지난 4월 민주당 경기도지사 경선에서 추미애 의원에게 패배했다. 같은 달 20일 도지사직에 복귀해 곧 임기 마무리를 앞두고 있다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Real Estate May Stir in Second Half... Need to Adjust Holding and Transfer Taxes" (김용범 “하반기 부동산 꿈틀할 수도…보유·양도세 조정 필요”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "Real Estate May Stir in Second Half... Need to Adjust Holding and Transfer Taxes" (김용범 “하반기 부동산 꿈틀할 수도…보유·양도세 조정 필요”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Office’s policy department, described the South Korean economy on the 20th as experiencing "an unprecedented boom," and stated that adjustments to holding taxes and transfer taxes are necessary to normalize real estate taxation. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 20일 한국 경제 상황을 ‘역대급 호황’이라고 평가하면서 부동산 과세 정상화 차원에서 보유세와 양도세 조정이 필요하다고 했다.)

In a lengthy post of about 40 pages of 200-character manuscript paper on Facebook titled "The Joy, Unfamiliarity, and Fear of a Nominal High-Teen Economy," Kim said, "Indicators such as stock prices, operating profits, tax revenues, and the current account balance are all pointing in a positive direction. This boom is not an illusion; it is real." He added, "South Korea's nominal GDP growth rate is expected to exceed double digits this year." (김 실장은 이날 페이스북에 올린 200자 원고지 40페이지 분량의 글 ‘명목 10% 후반 경제의 환희, 낯섦, 그리고 두려움’에서 “주가와 영업이익, 세수, 경상수지라는 숫자들이 일제히 좋은 방향을 가리키고 있다. 이번 호황은 착시가 아니고 진짜”라며 “올해 한국 경제의 명목 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률이 두 자릿수를 넘어설 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "By the second half of the year, luxury consumption may revive, and the sentiment to purchase real estate in preferred areas could start stirring again. The real turning point will be at the end of the year and early next year." He noted, "When bonuses are paid, wage hikes materialize, and export proceeds begin flowing into the country in earnest, people's behavior changes. Looking back at the past, such money has tended to repeatedly flow into the real estate market." (그러면서 “하반기가 되면 명품 소비가 살아나고 선호 지역의 부동산 매수 심리도 다시 꿈틀거리기 시작할 수 있다. 진짜 고비는 연말과 내년 초”라며 “성과급이 지급되고 임금 인상이 현실화하고 수출 대금이 국내로 본격적으로 유입되기 시작하면 사람들의 행동이 달라진다. 과거를 돌아보면, 이런 돈은 결국 부동산 시장으로 흘러들어가는 경향을 반복해왔다”고 했다.)

Kim stated, "We need to normalize real estate taxation. Reasonably adjusting holding and transfer taxes is both necessary and the right direction. If people are convinced that it's a profitable business even after paying taxes, any regulation may not be sufficient." This is interpreted as suggesting a potential increase in holding and transfer taxes. (김 살장은 “부동산 과세를 정상화해야 한다. 보유세와 양도세를 합리적으로 조정하는 것은 필요하고 옳은 방향”이라며 “세금을 내고도 남는 장사라는 확신이 생기면 어지간한 규제로는 역부족일 수 있다”고 말했다. 보유세와 양도세를 인상할 수 있다는 취지로 해석된다.)

Kim said, "If the national wealth generated by semiconductors is absorbed into real estate unearned income, and the fruits of growth are concentrated only among a minority, this boom will not last long." He added, "Conversely, if we can channel fiscal capacity and corporate profits to the youth, vulnerable groups, and future industries, this boom could serve as a starting point to escape the low-growth tunnel that the Korean economy has been stuck in for a long time." He emphasized, "An unprecedented boom requires commensurate imagination and the execution power to turn that imagination into reality." (김 실장은 “반도체가 벌어온 국부가 부동산 불로소득으로 흡수되고 성장의 과실이 소수에게만 집중된다면 이번 호황은 오래가지 못할 것”이라며 “반대로 재정 여력과 기업 이익을 청년과 취약 계층, 미래 산업으로 연결할 수 있다면 이번 호황은 한국 경제가 오랫동안 벗어나지 못했던 저성장의 터널을 빠져나오는 출발점이 될 수 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “역대급 호황은 그에 걸맞은 상상력과 그 상상력을 현실로 옮길 수 있는 실행력을 함께 요구한다”고 강조했다.)

Earlier last month, Kim proposed a "national dividend system" to return excess tax revenues to the people, stating, "The fruits of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure era are not the result of any single company alone." (앞서 김 실장은 지난달에도 “인공지능(AI) 인프라 시대의 과실은 특정 기업만이 끌어낸 결과가 아니다”라며 초과 세수를 국민에게 환원하기 위한 ‘국민 배당금제’를 제안한 바 있다.)
